title: @bsh/degent-studio environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Secrets (marked x-secret) come from the secret store, never from the repo. Variables marked x-required-unless-regtest may be omitted only when NETWORK=regtest (dev defaults: in-memory stores, an ephemeral session signing key, generated dev API keys logged at startup).

NETWORK.description: Bitcoin network artists sign in on; SIWB challenges and payout addresses must be for it.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Absolute base for contentUrl in responses, e.g. https://studio.degent.club. Empty = relative paths.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite database file (artists, artworks, royalties, SIWB nonces).

CONTENT_DIR.description: Content-addressed blob directory (<dir>/<aa>/<sha256>) for artwork bytes.

SIWB_DOMAIN.description: Lower-case host[:port] the SIWB challenge is bound to, e.g. studio.degent.club. Regtest default: localhost:8790.

SIWB_URI.description: URI line of the challenge; its host must equal SIWB_DOMAIN. Default https://<SIWB_DOMAIN> (http for localhost).

SIWB_STATEMENT.description: Optional one-line statement shown in the challenge.

SESSION_SIGNING_KEY.description: 32-byte Ed25519 secret (hex) signing artist session JWTs.

SESSION_PREVIOUS_KEYS.description: Comma-separated <kid>:<public key hex> pairs still accepted after a rotation.

SESSION_KID.description: Key id written into session headers.

API_KEYS.description: JSON array of @bsh/edge key records [{"id","hash","scopes":["studio:review"|"studio:internal"],"env"?}] holding only SHA-256 hashes of keys. Regtest without it: dev keys are generated and logged.

API_KEY_ENVIRONMENT.description: Only accept keys of this environment. Default: live on mainnet, test elsewhere.

VISION_REVIEW_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Unset: no vision review; every submission that passes the rules waits for a house reviewer (needsHuman).

VISION_REVIEW_GUIDELINES_FILE.description: Optional text file replacing the default Degent design guidelines prompt.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot API token (<bot id>:<secret>) for artist notifications (ADR-0012). Unset: artists can register webhooks only (GET /v1/config notifyChannels = [webhook]).

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact origins allowed for browser calls. Empty = deny all.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of reverse proxies we run. X-Forwarded-For is honoured only from these peers.

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Mutating (POST/PUT/DELETE) requests per client IP per minute.
